covenants.text: ARTICLE VI FINANCIAL COVENANTS On and after the Effective Date, until Payment in Full, the Borrower covenants and agrees with the Lenders that, in each case, commencing with the Test Period ending September 30, 2026: (a) The Borrower will not permit the Interest Coverage Ratio to be less than 2.75:1.00 as of the last day of each Test Period;

“ Applicable Rate ” means a percentage per annum to be determined in accordance with the pricing grid set forth below, based on the Borrower’s Net Total Leverage Ratio; provided , however , that the Applicable Rate indicated by Level IV shall be in effect from the Effective Date through the date of delivery of the Borrower’s financial statements and compliance certificate for the first fiscal quarter ending after the

Payment; provided that (i) no Default or Event of Default shall have occurred and be continuing or would result therefrom, (ii) after giving effect thereto, the Borrower shall be in compliance, on a Pro Forma Basis (including pro forma for any use of cash in making such Restricted Payment), with a Net Total Leverage Ratio of less than 3.00:1.00 and (iii) after giving effect to such Restricted Payment, the Borrower s

fter giving effect thereto, the Borrower shall be in compliance, on a Pro Forma Basis (including pro forma for any use of cash in making such Restricted Payment), with a Net Total Leverage Ratio of less than 3.00:1.00 and (iii) after giving effect to such Restricted Payment, the Borrower shall have minimum Liquidity of at least $50,000,000;
